before.title: Synthetic sync checkpoint read and controlled advancement

target.note: LP-7 reviews membership and revocation boundaries; synthetic-only checkpoint advancement.

before.downstream: Runtime SELECT is tenant-scoped; SECURITY DEFINER advancement rechecks active membership, rejects contractor revocation, stale revisions and non-synthetic environments. No direct runtime checkpoint writes.
gaps: Synthetic provider port only; no mounted endpoint or approved-region live sync deployment.

after.title: Synthetic sync checkpoint read and controlled advancement

target.note: LP-7 reviews membership and revocation boundaries; synthetic-only checkpoint advancement.

after.downstream: Runtime SELECT is tenant-scoped; checkpoint advancement requires a transaction binding whose membership identity user matches the requested user in the same tenant. Missing, revoked, expired or contractor-revoked membership refuses without writes. Synthetic-database, environment and stale revision guards remain enforced; no direct runtime checkpoint writes.
gaps: Synthetic provider port only; no mounted endpoint or approved-region live sync deployment.

before.title: Synthetic sync checkpoint authority
before.description: Verified tenant context and current membership bound durable synthetic download generations; no live adapter or token authority is granted.
gaps: Synthetic provider port only; no mounted endpoint or approved-region live sync deployment.

after.title: Synthetic sync checkpoint authority
after.description: The authenticated transaction membership ID resolves to its identity user in the bound tenant; caller-selected users and unbound requests cannot advance synthetic download generations. No live adapter or token authority is granted.
gaps: Synthetic provider port only; no mounted endpoint or approved-region live sync deployment.
